name: Tally
description: Keeps named counts that survive restarts. A small script package written in TypeScript: typed handlers, durable this.data, and settings read from the Packages service.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Count `by` occurrences of `name` (the Step setting when by is omitted). Returns { name, count, unit }.

methods.name: counts
methods.description: Every count so far. Returns { unit, counts }.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clear one count, or all of them when no name is given. Returns { counts }.

events.name: counted
events.description: A count changed (only when the Announce setting is on); payload { name, count }
